labels.titleRequired: Opgavetitel er påkrævet. Eksempel: ag + Forbered præsentation @today p:high +arbejde
labels.selectorRequired: Opgavenummer eller søgeord påkrævet. Eksempel: ag ok 1
labels.searchRequired: Søgeord er påkrævet. Eksempel: ag find faktura
labels.confirmYesRequired: Angiv --yes for at bekræfte permanent handling.
labels.helpHint: Kør "ag help" (kommandohjælp: "ag <cmd> --help", alle: "ag help all") for brug.
labels.shortHelp:
Agendamea CLI v{version} (ag | agenda | agendamea)

Terminal- og CLI-kommandoer (ag):
  ag                                 undefined
  ag + <title> [@today] [p:high]     undefined
  ag show 1                          undefined
  ag ok 1                            undefined
  ag rm 2                            undefined
  ag find <q>                        undefined
  ag undo                            undefined
  ag stat                            undefined

MCP-server (AI-assistentintegration) / undefined:
  ag mcp [list|install|doctor]       MCP-klientintegrationer
  ag serve [start|stop|status]       undefined
  ag hook [set|logs|outbox|test]     Webhook-udbakkekø (Outbox)
  ag ai [status|models|download]     Lokal AI-hardware og modelstatus
  ag doctor                          Agendamea systemsundhedstjek (Doctor)
  ag help [cmd|all]                  Kør "ag help" (kommandohjælp: "ag <cmd> --help", alle: "ag help all") for brug.
labels.fullHelp:
Agendamea CLI v{version} - undefined

OPGAVER:
  ag [today|imp|done|/Category]      undefined
  ag + <title> [@today] [p:high]     undefined
  ag show <1|id|keyword>             undefined
  ag edit <1|id|keyword> [fields]    undefined
  ag ok <1|id|keyword>               undefined
  ag rm <1|id|keyword>               undefined
  ag find <keyword>                  undefined
  ag matrix                          undefined

DELOPGAVER / KATEGORIER / PAPIRKURV:
  ag sub <task> [+ | ok | edit | rm] undefined
  ag cat [+ | edit | move | rm]      undefined
  ag trash [-q | delete | empty]     undefined
  ag undo [1|keyword]                undefined

INDSTILLINGER / MCP-SERVER (AI-ASSISTENTINTEGRATION):
  ag export / ag import / ag sync    undefined
  ag config [key value|--list]       undefined
  ag serve [start|stop|status]       undefined
  ag hook [set|logs|outbox|test]     Webhook-udbakkekø (Outbox)
  ag mcp [list|install|doctor]       MCP-klientintegrationer
  ag doctor                          Agendamea systemsundhedstjek (Doctor)
